title: Networking Fundamentals (TCP/IP & OSI Model)
description: Learn the OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing, TCP vs UDP, common ports, and DNS — the foundation for Wireshark and Nmap.

title: Wireshark Basics
description: Capture and analyze network traffic using Wireshark. Learn to read packets, apply filters, and identify common protocols.

title: Git & Version Control Basics
description: Learn the core Git workflow: init, add, commit, push, pull, and branching. Essential for all programming and security scripting work.

title: Linux Command Line Basics
description: Master essential Linux commands for navigating the file system, managing files, viewing processes, and working with permissions.

title: OSINT & Reconnaissance Basics
description: Learn passive reconnaissance techniques — search operators, WHOIS/DNS recon, theHarvester, and Shodan — and how to reduce your own exposure.

title: Nmap Network Scanning
description: Learn to use Nmap to discover hosts, scan open ports, detect services, and identify operating systems on a network.

title: Cryptography Fundamentals
description: Understand symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hashing, salting, and digital signatures — the concepts behind HTTPS, SSH, and password storage.

title: Password Cracking Basics (John the Ripper & Hashcat)
description: Learn how password hashes are attacked using dictionary, brute-force, and rule-based techniques, and how to defend against them.

title: Web Application Security Basics
description: An introduction to the OWASP Top 10, including SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and broken authentication, plus an intro to Burp Suite.

title: Metasploit Basics
description: Learn the core Metasploit workflow — searching modules, configuring exploits, working with payloads, and managing sessions in a lab environment.

title: Python for Security Scripting
description: Use Python to automate common security tasks: running system tools, basic networking, parsing logs, and calling web APIs.

title: Digital Forensics Basics
description: Learn forensic imaging, hash verification, file carving, memory forensics with Volatility, and timeline analysis with Autopsy.

title: Malware Analysis Basics
description: Learn safe static and dynamic malware analysis techniques, sandboxing, and how to extract indicators of compromise (IOCs).

title: SOC Basics: SIEM & Log Analysis
description: Learn how SOC analysts use SIEM platforms like Splunk and ELK to search, correlate, and triage security alerts from log data.
